en.<p class=\"eyebrow\">Wave Washer</p> <h2:
Wave Washer

Wave Washer

A spring-steel washer bent into a wave shape, used to apply a spring preload or absorb clearance between parts in a bearing housing or along a shaft. Unlike a flat washer, it can elastically deform in the thickness (t) direction, continuously compensating for axial play caused by temperature changes or component wear. The spec codes are WW for general use and BWW for bearing use.

Wave Washer

波形垫圈 (Wave Washer)

弯曲成波浪形的弹簧钢垫圈,用于在轴承壳体或轴向施加弹簧预紧力或吸收零件间的间隙。与平垫圈不同,它能在厚度(t)方向发生弹性变形,从而持续补偿因温度变化或零件磨损产生的轴向间隙。规格代号中,通用型为WW,轴承用为BWW。
